---
name: Bug report
about: A reproducible correctness, build or documentation defect
title: ""
---

## Problem

Expected versus actual behavior. Is this a build, geometry, I/O, artifact or
documentation defect? For possible vulnerabilities, use SECURITY.md first.

## Reproduction

Exact commit, OS, compiler, CMake version, preset and command. Provide a minimal
**project-authored synthetic** fixture or steps using the public generators.

## Evidence

Concise diagnostic, relevant accounting/status fields and tests tried. Label
anything not run. Never attach KITTI content, derived images, credentials or
private absolute paths; sanitize logs before posting.
